parameters.help_en: The name of the batch operation task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the batch operation task
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: sends a check request and does not create the batch card operation task. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the check, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request and creates the batch card operation task after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建批量操作卡任务。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查直接创建批量操作卡任务
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the 5G Cloud Connector instances. You can specify up to 10 IDs
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_ids

parameters.help_en:
The restriction type. Valid values:

BreakNetwork: disconnects the network when the data usage reaches the threshold.
LimitRate: throttles the bandwidth when the data usage reaches the threshold.
Alarm: triggers an alert when the data usage reaches the threshold
parameters.help_zh:
限制类型，取值：

BreakNetwork: 达量断网
LimitRate: 达量限速
Alarm: 达量告警
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en: The data usage threshold. Unit: MB
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The effective period. Valid values:

CurrentMonth: takes effect in the current month.
ContinualMonth: takes effect continuously
parameters.help_zh:
生效类型，取值：

CurrentMonth：当月生效
ContinualMonth：连续生效
parameters.name: effect_type
